title: Set CloudWatch log group retention
description: Updates RetentionInDays on a log group via Cloud Control JSON Patch semantics.
template: UPDATE aws.cloud_control.resources SET PatchDocument = string('[{"op":"replace","path":"/RetentionInDays","value":{{retention_days}}}]') WHERE region = '{{region}}' AND TypeName = 'AWS::Logs::LogGroup' AND Identifier = '{{log_group_name}}';
notes: Cloud Control mutations are asynchronous: the response is a progress event. Check completion via aws.cloud_control.resource_requests or by re-reading the resource. The PatchDocument is an RFC 6902 JSON Patch array against current state, wrapped in string(...).
